summary: Tested all 9 features for ACTOOS ONE multi-country super-app. 8/9 features PASS. Admin email login fails due to Supabase auth issue (same as iteration 88).

critical.issue: Admin login (contact@actoos.com / Salifkane&&7) returns 'Invalid login credentials'. Admin account may not exist in Supabase Auth.

action_items: Create/verify admin account (contact@actoos.com) in Supabase Auth with password 'Salifkane&&7'
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 features tested and working except admin email login (Supabase auth issue). Multi-country auth UI fully functional. Wallet with QR Payer/Encaisser working. Order flow working.

test_1_restaurants_bamako.details: Homepage displays 16 restaurants from Bamako (Mali) including: Maquis Chez Tanti, Fast Food Bamako, Pizza Mama Africa, Grillades de Bamako, Cafe de Paris Bamako, Poulet Braise Express, Shawarma King, Thieboudienne House

test_2_login_tabs.details: LoginSheet has [Téléphone] | [Email] tabs with data-testid='login-tab-phone' and 'login-tab-email'

test_3_mali_default.details: Mali flag 🇲🇱 and +223 code displayed by default in country selector

test_4_country_dropdown.details: Dropdown shows all 10 West African countries: Mali, Sénégal, Côte d'Ivoire, Burkina Faso, Guinée, Niger, Togo, Bénin, Guinée-Bissau, Mauritanie. NO 'BIENTÔT' badge present (as required).

test_5_placeholder_change.details: Phone placeholder changes when country selected. Sénégal shows '77 000 00 00', Mali shows '70 00 00 00'

test_6_signup_form.details: Signup form has: Nom complet * (required), Phone * (required with country selector), Email (optionnel), Mot de passe * (required). Email correctly marked as optional.

test_7_admin_email_login.details: Admin email login (contact@actoos.com / Salifkane&&7) fails with 'Invalid login credentials' - Supabase auth data issue, not frontend bug

test_8_order_flow.details: Order flow working: Click restaurant > View menu (Accompagnements, Boissons, Plats) > Click item (Alloco 1,000 FCFA) > Item detail modal with quantity selector and 'AJOUTER AU PANIER' button > Cart badge updates

test_9_wallet_qr.details: ACTOOS Pay wallet fully functional: Solde disponible, Recharger, Envoyer, Payer (QR), Encaisser (QR). Payer avec QR shows Scanner and Code manuel options with camera permission request.

mocked_apis.Twilio SMS OTP: MOCKED - OTP code displayed in UI for testing (devCode field)

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Admin email login fails with 'Invalid login credentials'
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Admin account (contact@actoos.com) either doesn't exist in Supabase Auth or has different password
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Verify/create admin account in Supabase Auth dashboard with email: contact@actoos.com and password: Salifkane&&7
